claims.statement: TestSprite verifies features against live applications rather than mocks
Automatically heals UI tests when page elements change
Generates readable test cases in plain English describing actions and assertions
Reduces UI test failure rates after changes from approximately 30% to under 5%
Causes false positive failures due to locale-specific date formats without configuration
Provides GitHub Actions and Jenkins integrations for CI/CD pipelines
Generates test plans from product specifications combined with observed app behavior
TestSprite has a free plan and paid plans whose limits are measured partly in monthly credits

featureTranslations.plainExplanation: Automatically updates test scripts when UI elements change position or properties
featureTranslations.whoCares: Teams with frequent UI iterations avoiding test maintenance
featureTranslations.whenItDoesNotMatter: For static applications with infrequent interface changes

featureTranslations.plainExplanation: Generates tests from product requirement documents rather than only code analysis
featureTranslations.whoCares: Teams wanting requirement-coverage metrics and behavior-driven testing
featureTranslations.whenItDoesNotMatter: When working without formal product specifications

scoreRationale.onboarding: Reported as straightforward with first results in ~10 minutes (official-site) and 20 minutes for test generation (community-seed-1)
scoreRationale.product: Strong on automated test maintenance and live verification but shows gaps in locale handling and brittle assertions
scoreRationale.support: Undocumented locale configuration noted, with workarounds requiring API doc research
scoreRationale.billing: Official pricing lists a free plan with 150 monthly credits, Starter at $19 per month after the first month, and Standard at $69 per month
scoreRationale.overall: Effective for test maintenance reduction with limitations in internationalization support

conflictsAndUnknowns: Conflicting regression rates: Official-site claims 12-25% agent regression while community-seed-1 reports 30% test failure rate pre-TestSprite
Unknown pricing structure beyond community-reported free tier
Unverified support responsiveness beyond documentation gaps
